# BillShock — Full Repository & Documentation Context (`v1.1.0`)

BillShock (`billshock-audit` v1.1.0) is a zero-dependency Python 3.10+ static spend-safety analyzer and CI gate designed to prevent overnight cloud, AI LLM, and database bills before deployment.

- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/billshock/
- Interactive Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/billshock/studio.html
- Docs: https://codesphere-u.github.io/billshock/docs.html
- Getting Started: https://github.com/codesphere-u/billshock/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
- CI & Remediation: https://github.com/codesphere-u/billshock/blob/main/docs/CI_AND_REMEDIATION.md
- Rule Spec: https://github.com/codesphere-u/billshock/blob/main/skills/billshock/references/rules.md
